newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM denies buying back stocks of units.
newsitem.headline: RFM denies buying back stocks of units.

text.p: Philippine food and beverage conglomerate RFM Corp is not buying stocks of its subsidiaries on the Philippine Stock Exchange, a senior official said on Tuesday.

"We are not buying, that is not our style. Besides we are not allowed to buy back unless there is approval from the Securities and Exchange Commission," RFM spokesman B.J. Sebastian told Reuters by phone.
Rumours that RFM was buying stocks of its three subsidiaries shored up prices of the RFM group of companies in late trade.
RFM'S ice cream unit Selecta Dairy Products Inc soared by 30.51 percent, or by 36 centavos, to 1.54 pesos.

Its meat processing arm Swift Foods Inc also jumped by 8.89 percent, or by 16 centavos, to 1.96 pesos, while its softdrinks arm Cosmos Bottling Corp jumped 7.78 percent, or by 35 centavos, to 4.85 pesos.
RFM's shares also increased by 7.5 percent, or by 30 centavos, to 4.30 pesos.
